{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check for commas in the revenue strings
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check if any revenue is extremely high (potential QA orders)
high_revenue = df[df['revenue_clean'] > 100000]
print(f"Number of orders with revenue > $100,000: {len(high_revenue)}")

# Check if any revenue is negative
negative_revenue = df[df['revenue_clean'] < 0]
print(f"Number of orders with negative revenue: {len(negative_revenue)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")"}
